research_adaptive_turns.create_table:
CREATE TABLE research_adaptive_turns (
	step_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	turn_number INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	execution_snapshot_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_by_attempt_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	query VARCHAR(4000) NOT NULL, 
	request_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	result_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	result_json JSONB NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (step_id, turn_number), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_research_adaptive_turn_bound CHECK (turn_number >= 0 AND turn_number <= 2), 
	FOREIGN KEY(step_id) REFERENCES research_steps (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(execution_snapshot_id) REFERENCES research_execution_snapshots (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(created_by_attempt_id) REFERENCES research_step_attempts (id)
)
